# Generated assets into the place

1. Generate the asset.
2. Fit meshes with a Blender script (blender): decimate each mesh to at most 20,000
   triangles, apply scale and rotation, export FBX or glTF.
3. `voyager roblox assets upload FILE --type model|decal|image|audio|video --json` waits and
   returns `assetId`. The asset belongs to the key's own Roblox account; add `--group ID` only
   when the user asks for a group. Without a key, tell the user: add your Roblox Open Cloud key in
   Connectors › Services › Roblox (made at create.roblox.com/dashboard/credentials with the Assets
   API, Read and Write). A rejected key: they replace it there.
4. Insert with the Studio MCP `insert_asset` tool, or set `rbxassetid://ID` through `execute_luau`.

Roblox facts: 20 MB per file; images under 8000×8000; audio up to 7 minutes, 100 uploads a
month when ID-verified, 10 otherwise; video 20 a day, 13+ and ID-verified; models arrive as
packages; images and audio can't be updated. Every upload is moderated, sometimes later:
`voyager roblox assets status ID --asset`.

---
name: roblox-studio
description: "."
applications:
  - id: roblox-studio
    role: primary
voyager:
  schemaVersion: 1
---

Ask first, unless the request or project already answers it:

- A new place or an existing one?
- Rojo project files, or Studio only?
- Which assets: textures, models, sound, music, icon, thumbnails, trailer?

Know:

- Studio's tools come from its built-in MCP server; `voyager roblox connect` adds it to
  Voyager's integrations and tests it, so its tools then appear with the other integration tools.
  It works only while Studio is open, signed in, with Enable Studio as MCP server switched on
  (Assistant → … → Manage MCP Servers), a switch only the user can turn on. When connect fails or
  finds no tools, relay its hint's steps to the user and run it again once they're done; never
  carry on without Studio's tools unannounced.
- Rojo: `rokit add rojo-rbx/rojo`, `rojo init`, `rojo plugin install`, `rojo serve`; the user
  presses Connect in the Rojo plugin.
- Meshes: at most 20,000 triangles, watertight. Make them through blender’s 3D generation models (Meshy,
  Tripo), fit them in blender. make-image makes textures, the 512×512 icon and 1920×1080
  thumbnails; make-sound and make-music the audio (under 7 minutes and 20 MB).
- Upload generated assets with the user's Roblox key from Connectors › Services › Roblox and
  insert them with [upload-assets.md](references/upload-assets.md), or the user imports files:
  models via File → Import 3D (FBX, glTF, OBJ), images and audio via the Asset Manager.
- A video thumbnail must be real gameplay without voice-over or lyrics: record with
  screen-capture, cut with edit-video.

## Asset Sources

`voyager assets search <words> [--type texture|hdri|model|icon|music|pack] [--source …]` and
`voyager assets download <source>:<id> [--resolution 2k]` cover Poly Haven, ambientCG and Kenney
(CC0), game-icons.net and Incompetech; downloads land in `assets/<source>/<id>/` with a receipt
and a `CREDITS` line. An asset you get another way gets the same by hand: `<asset-id>.json`
beside its files (`source`, `id`, `title`, `url`, `authors`, `license`, `licenseUrl`,
`attribution`, `acquiredAt`, `files`) and a `CREDITS` line (title, author, source URL, licence).

- Tell users Poly Haven assets come from Poly Haven. Kenney search matches pack names only.
- game-icons.net is CC BY 3.0, credited per icon author; Incompetech is CC BY 4.0 with Kevin
  MacLeod's credit text, single tracks only.
- Lospec palettes: `https://lospec.com/palette-list/<slug>.json`; credit "<palette> by <author>
  (Lospec)", taking the author from the page when the JSON's is empty.
- Godot Asset Library (plugins and scripts, not art):
  `godotengine.org/asset-library/api/asset?filter=…&godot_version=4.3` (nothing without
  `godot_version`); `cost` is the licence, `/asset/<id>` gives `download_url`.
- OpenGameArt has no API: search pages only, 10 s crawl delay, `/search/` disallowed; licences
  per page.
- Mixamo and itch.io: the user downloads in their own browser (Mixamo's terms forbid other
  access, and its assets aren't redistributable raw; itch.io has no public API).
